title: Cloud concepts
summary: The models, service types and benefits the cloud is described with. Each tile gives a definition; the slip is the term.

iaas.clue: You rent servers, storage and networks, and manage the operating system yourself

paas.clue: You deploy your application; the provider manages the operating system and runtime

saas.clue: You use finished software over the internet, such as email or office apps

public-cloud.clue: A provider's resources, shared by many customers over the internet

private-cloud.clue: Cloud resources used by a single organization only

hybrid-cloud.clue: Public cloud and your own datacenter, working together as one environment

consumption-based.clue: A pricing model: you're charged only for what you use, and stop paying when you stop using it

serverless.clue: You run code without managing any servers, and are billed when it runs

capex.clue: Spending up front on physical infrastructure you then own

opex.clue: Ongoing spending with nothing paid up front, accounted for in the period it's spent

high-availability.clue: A service stays up despite failures, measured as uptime in an SLA

reliability.clue: A system recovers from failures and keeps functioning

predictability.clue: You can know in advance what performance and costs will be

horizontal-scaling.clue: Adding more instances, such as virtual machines, to share the load

vertical-scaling.clue: Giving an existing virtual machine more CPU or memory
